schema.title: Spectoda Controller config 0.12.11
schema.description: Firmware-derived schema for Controller config. Unknown or unsupported keys produce advisory Studio warnings but never block writing syntactically valid JSON objects.

fps.description: Render frames per second. The selected ESP32 build uses CONFIG_FREERTOS_HZ=100.

autosave.description: Event-state autosave. true uses the build default; false disables; a number sets milliseconds (minimum 1000).

oneOf.description: ESP log level: 0 none, 1 error, 2 warn, 3 info, 4 debug, 5 verbose.

debug.description: Global console log level or boolean shortcut.

websocket.description: Enable or disable the WebSocket service.

btn.description: GPIO for btn; -1 means not connected. Decorators may occur anywhere: ! invert, + pull-up, - pull-down.

!btn+.description: Decorated btn example: inverted with internal pull-up; -1 means not connected.

button.description: Deprecated bare button alias with implicit inversion and internal pull-up. Decorated button aliases are invalid; use the same decorators on btn.
